## Policy Deployment

> This tutorial requires users to have a trained model checkpoint and a physical So100 Lerobot robot to run the policy.

In this tutorial, we will show example scripts and code snippets for deploying a trained policy. We will use the So100 Lerobot robotic arm as an example.

![alt text](../../../../10-具身智能其他仿真工具及仿真前沿/Isaac-GR00T/media/so100_eval_demo.gif)

### 1. Loading Policy

Run the following command to start the policy server.

```bash
python scripts/inference_service.py --server \
    --model_path <PATH_TO_YOUR_CHECKPOINT> \
    --embodiment_tag new_embodiment \
    --data_config so100 \
    --denoising_steps 4
```

- Model path is the checkpoint path for the policy. Users should provide the fine-tuned checkpoint path.
- Denoising steps are the number of denoising steps in the policy. We found that using 4 denoising steps has a similar effect to 16 steps.
- Implementation label is the implementation label for the policy. Users should use new_embodiment when fine-tuning on a new robot.
- Data configuration is the data configuration for the policy. Users should use `so100`. If they want to use a different robot, please implement their own `ModalityConfig` and `TransformConfig`

### 2. Client nodes

To deploy the fine-tuned model, you can use the `scripts/inference_policy.py` script. This script will start a policy server.

The client node can be implemented using the `from gr00t.eval.service import ExternalRobotInferenceClient` class. This class is a standalone client-server class that can communicate with the policy server, and `get_action()` is the unique interface endpoint.

```python
from gr00t.eval.service import ExternalRobotInferenceClient
from typing import Dict, Any

raw_obs_dict: Dict[str, Any] = {} # 填写空白处

policy = ExternalRobotInferenceClient(host="localhost", port=5555)
raw_action_chunk: Dict[str, Any] = policy.get_action(raw_obs_dict)
```

Users can directly copy this type and implement their own client nodes in a separate isolated environment.

### Example of So100 Lerobot robotic arm

We provided an example client node implementation for the So100 Lerobot robotic arm. For more detailed information, please refer to the example script `scripts/eval_gr00t_so100.py`.


Users can run the following command to start the client node.
```bash
python examples/eval_gr00t_so100.py \
 --use_policy --host <YOUR_POLICY_SERVER_HOST> \
 --port <YOUR_POLICY_SERVER_PORT> \
 --camera_index <YOUR_CAMERA_INDEX>
```

This will activate the robot and call the `action = get_action(obs)` endpoint of the policy server to obtain an action, which is then executed on the robot.
